# E0605: versions that don't agree

A program holds one version of each package, the highest that any manifest asks for, and that version removes what another manifest needs. Ask for a version that keeps it, or change the code that needs it.

- Rule: [`versions.compatible-selections`](../../reference/21-versions.md#versions.compatible-selections)
- Reported at: the first entry of the root's manifest through which the requests arrive.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0605_selection_that_removes`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0605_selection_that_removes):

`deps/http/src/main.lt`:

use json.decode

pub fn get(url: str) -> f64 { decode.parse_float(url) }
